title: Record envelope
description: Every DTP record shares this wrapper. The signature is Ed25519 over the canonical JSON (RFC 8785, integer-only numbers) of the envelope minus `signature`.

root_id.description: record_id of the first record in this supersession chain; equals record_id for a genesis record. Bodies cross-reference entities by root_id.

subject_company_id.description: Whose cabinet this record lives in.

counterparty_ids.description: Other parties to this record. Required non-empty when visibility is `counterparties`.

company_id.description: The principal. Must be subject_company_id or a member of counterparty_ids.

module_id.description: Set when a module key signs on the company's behalf under a core.grant.

created_at.description: Writer clock. The store records its own received_at on the event.

supersedes.description: record_id of the current head of the chain this record replaces, or null for a genesis record.

body.description: Validated against the schema registered for (type, schema_version). Integers only; decimals are strings.
